{{Quote|Who, Zero? Oh, I suppose he's been known to visit Ventilation Conduit 11-AZR, is maybe one place he's been known to entertain visitors, from time to time. Of course that's just hearsay, isn't it? Nothing guaranteed, is there?|Coyle, to Darth Maul|<ref name="Lockdown" />}}
'''Ventilation Conduit 11-AZR''' was a ventilation conduit on the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. During his undercover [[mission to Cog Hive Seven]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was told by inmate [[Coyle]] that a fellow inmate known as [[Dakarai Blirr|Zero]] often visited Ventilation Conduit 11-AZR. However, Maul did not find Zero there, as the latter was afraid that the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] inmate was going to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him. Later, Ventilation Conduit 11-AZR was destroyed along with the whole prison when [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Sadiki Blirr]] initiated a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct process]] on board the space station.<ref name="Lockdown" />
